name: Old Rauma
description: Old Rauma is the wooden heart of a Finnish port town on the Gulf of Bothnia, with about 600 mostly one-storey buildings packed into roughly 0.3 square kilometres. Its streets still follow a medieval plan, even though fires in the 1600s destroyed much of the town and the surviving houses date from the 1700s onward. Visitors can wander narrow alleys, tour old seamen's and shipowners' houses turned museums, and see medieval paintings in the Church of the Holy Cross.
